name: One Time Login Link Admin
description: Generate one time login link for user from admin UI
project_description:
Generate a one-time login link for the user from the admin UI in Drupal8 or Drupal9 

 This module provides an option in the people's page in Drupal admin from which an admin user can generate a one-time login link for any user.

 

 

 Why you need this? 
 

You can generate a one-time login link using Drush but for this again you need server ssh access. This module will provide you an option from Drupal admin UI where you can generate the one-time login link without any server access.

 

 

 How to use 
 

 
 Click on the Edit arrow button beside any user in the list, it will generate the one-time login link for the user and will be shown at the top of the page.
